performance-efficiency.core_concern: Performance relative to the amount of resources used under stated conditions, encompassing time behaviour, resource utilization, and capacity.
classify_if: Specifies response times, processing times, or throughput for operations.
Constrains CPU, memory, storage, bandwidth, or energy consumption.
Specifies maximum limits on concurrent users, transactions, data volume, or bandwidth.
Specifies performance under a defined load, network condition, or workload.
Requires batch or background processing to complete within a time or resource limit.
Specifies future or increased capacity requirements beyond current load targets.
Requires horizontal or vertical scaling by adding resources without unacceptable degradation.
performance-efficiency.boundary_notes: Performance Efficiency covers speed, resource use, and capacity. Reliability concerns correct operation over time. Flexibility (Scalability sub-characteristic) concerns structural adaptation to growth beyond adding resources. Compatibility concerns exchange with other systems.

compatibility.core_concern: How well the product can share an environment with other products and exchange information with them, without negative impact on either side.
classify_if: Requires the product to share resources or an environment with other products without degrading their performance.
Requires integration with a named external system, service, API, device, or platform.
Specifies communication protocols, message formats, data schemas, or interface contracts for information exchange.
Requires import, export, synchronization, or data sharing with external systems.
Requires compatibility or semantic consistency of exchanged data across systems or organisations.
compatibility.boundary_notes: Compatibility covers both co-existence (shared environments) and interoperability (information exchange). Flexibility covers adaptation to different technical environments. Maintainability covers internal modifiability.

interaction-capability.core_concern: How well the product can be operated by specified users to achieve their goals effectively, efficiently, and with satisfaction, covering learnability, operability, error protection, engagement, inclusivity, user assistance, and self-descriptiveness.
classify_if: Requires users to be able to recognise whether the product is appropriate for their needs.
Specifies ease of learning, training time, intuitiveness, or self-explanatory operation.
Specifies task completion time, success rate, error rate, or user satisfaction target.
Requires the product to protect users from making errors or to support recovery from them.
Requires the interface to be engaging, motivating, or to encourage continued use.
Requires accessibility for users with diverse characteristics, abilities, cultures, or languages.
Requires embedded user assistance such as help, guidance, or documentation within the product.
Requires the product to present context-appropriate information so users need not recall it or consult external sources.
interaction-capability.boundary_notes: Interaction Capability (formerly Usability) concerns human effectiveness in operating the system. Look-and-feel concerns visual or sensory presentation. Performance Efficiency concerns system speed. Legal or regulatory requirements may overlap when accessibility is externally mandated.

reliability.core_concern: How well the system performs specified functions under specified conditions for a specified period, including faultlessness, availability, fault tolerance, and recoverability.
classify_if: Requires the product to perform without faults under normal operating conditions.
Specifies uptime, downtime, service hours, availability windows, or recovery time/point objectives.
Requires failover, redundancy, graceful degradation, or continued service after component failure.
Requires the product to continue operating as intended despite hardware or software faults.
Requires recovery of affected data and re-establishment of desired state after a failure.
Specifies failure rates, defect rates, mean time between failures, or deterministic repeatable behaviour.
reliability.boundary_notes: Reliability covers faultless operation, access continuity, fault tolerance, and recoverability. Performance Efficiency concerns speed when the system is available. Security concerns protection from malicious actions. Safety concerns preventing physical harm.

security.core_concern: How well the product protects information and data so that access matches each actor's level of authorisation, including confidentiality, integrity, non-repudiation, accountability, authenticity, and resistance.
classify_if: Requires data to be accessible only to those authorised, including encryption or access control.
Requires prevention of unauthorised access to, or modification of, programs and data.
Requires that actions or events can be proven to have taken place and cannot be denied.
Requires that actions of an entity can be traced uniquely to that entity.
Requires verification or proof of the identity of a subject or resource.
Requires the product to continue operating correctly while under attack from malicious actors.
security.boundary_notes: Security is about protection from unauthorised or malicious actions. Reliability concerns continued correct operation under normal or faulty conditions. Legal/regulatory obligations may overlap when a named regulation mandates specific security controls.

maintainability.core_concern: How effectively and efficiently the product can be modified by its intended maintainers, covering modularity, reusability, analysability, modifiability, testability, and updateability.
classify_if: Requires modular components such that a change to one has minimal impact on others.
Requires assets or components to be reusable across systems or to build other assets.
Requires the ability to assess the impact of a change and diagnose defects or failure causes.
Requires the product to be modifiable without introducing defects or degrading existing quality.
Requires test criteria to be establishable and tests to be executable to verify compliance.
Requires the product to be updatable or upgradeable with effectiveness, efficiency, and minimal service disruption.
maintainability.boundary_notes: Maintainability concerns changing and sustaining the system over its lifetime. Flexibility concerns adaptation to different hardware or operational environments. Reliability concerns correct continued operation during normal use.

flexibility.core_concern: How well the product can be adapted to different or evolving hardware, software, or other operational or usage environments, covering adaptability, scalability, installability, and replaceability.
classify_if: Requires the product to be adapted for different or evolving hardware, software, or usage environments.
Requires the product to handle growing or shrinking workloads, or to adapt its capacity to changing demands without major re-architecture.
Requires the product to be successfully installed and/or uninstalled in a specified environment.
Requires the product to replace another specified product for the same purpose in the same environment.
Requires support for multiple operating systems, browsers, devices, hardware platforms, or cloud environments without environment-specific code changes.
flexibility.boundary_notes: Flexibility (formerly Portability) covers structural adaptation across environments and capacity growth requiring architectural change. Compatibility covers information exchange with other systems. Performance Efficiency covers speed and resource use at a given capacity. Maintainability covers internal code-level changeability.

safety.core_concern: How well the product avoids states in which human life, health, property, or the environment is endangered, covering operational constraints, risk identification, fail-safe behaviour, hazard warning, and safe integration.
classify_if: Requires the product to operate safely within defined operational limits or boundaries.
Requires identification of situations or events that could lead to risk or harm.
Requires the product to transition to a safe state when a failure occurs.
Requires the product to warn users or operators of identified hazards in time to react.
Requires the product to maintain safe behaviour when combined with other components or systems.
safety.boundary_notes: Safety concerns preventing harm to people, property, or the environment. Security concerns resisting unauthorised or malicious actions. Reliability supports safety but a requirement is classified as Safety only when harm or hazard is the explicit concern.
